tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// rgya sgom tshul khrims grags la spring ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ dpal sa skya'i dben gnas dam pa nas/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen bsod nams rtse mos/ dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba'i bshes gnyen rgya sgom tshul khrims grags la spring ba/ khyed bsnyun med cing dge sbyor 'gro don 'phel ba'i ngang nas/ bdag spun la bsnyun shog 'bul ba khyad par can dang bcas pa 'bu mes 'phrod/ sug par phyin pas phyag byad bzang zhing rjes su yi rang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ bdag cag rnams kyang bde zhing chos 'phel bar mchis/ 'bul ba'i gos kyi gyon rgyu rnams dang*/ zi pho lo srang phyed ma gtogs pa/ bla ma chen po'i dus dran la stobs pa bgyis/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs te/ khyed dngos slob mos thob yin pas thugs tshims par mdzod/ slad ma khams bzang zhing chos 'phel bar gsol ba 'debs zhing myur du mjal ba dang dmigs su bkar ba'i dod/ bla ma'i sku chings thung ngu 'di dri bsrung khyad par can ma yal ba bse'i ga 'ur btsud pa dang*/ bdag med ma'i dbang gi tho yig rgyud 'di nyid kyi lung sbyor ba mchan zhib tu byas pa/ bzang po yongs bzung gi yig sna gsung gi dpe ris bzhi/ nā ro pa nas kyi sin+dhu ra'i ru ma rnams khong pa rang la dam gnyer byas bskur bdog yang bla chen gyi bstod pa/ dge bshes gnyags dang*/ gnyan phul byung la dbyar phu ma gsum gyis zhus nas bgyis pa de la/ snyan ngag gi rgyan tshang che chung gnyis yod pa khyed kyi phyag tu byung mchi/ rting ma dus phyis byas pa/ nyung shas shig las med na'ang mang po bsams so la sogs kyis kyang thos nas bskur/ khyed la'ang 'di dgos pa yin bsams nas bskur bdog rje btsun na re/ bla chen lta bu'i dam pa la/ khyod lta bus byas pa la 'di bas rgyan dang snyan ngag tshang ba legs pa byed thang zer mod/ dus dran gyi tshe dad pa'i yus dmag byin brlabs kyi zing langs pas/

bsam long med par theb tshad byung*/ phyi se ba bris pas 'grig ting nge ba mi bdog ste/ phyis ma bcos sems la phan che bar byung*/ a po zhus byas pa de'ang*/ sdeb dang slob par gda' ste/ de rang kho na 'khul che/ phan che bar byung*/ slad ma chos 'phel ba mi g.yengs ba'i ngang nas myur du mjal zhing*/ bdag kyang sang phod snga se ba cig dbus la 'gro ba byung na/ zhar la lam du mjal nas/ gdams ngag dang rgyud kyi ma bde ba mchis pa/ zhib tu glengs nas tshim par byed/ yi ger 'dri lang ba tsam las med na'ang bris la bskur bcos pa yin/ da len ga ring rgyal pos bdag spun la byung ba'i ge'u ben zer ba'i gos chen ha las po zer ba 'dam gsum lhag ri mo zlum tshig gi dbus na dbyangs dgod pa 'di la ka ra'i glang po mchog gcig tu mchis/ bya lo zla ba gsum pa la bris pa/ 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
